newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse says system upgrade caused hitch.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse says system upgrade caused hitch.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange said the second phase of an upgrade to its screen-based system caused the problems which interrupted normal trading on Tuesday.
"The upgrade of the electronic screen based system, prepared by TCAM, had problems that could not be corrected during normal trading hours," it said in a statement.
"This is the reason trading was halted and the session restarted at 1315 local," the exchange said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
